senses.definition: (copulative, followed by an adjective or a noun) begin to be; turn into (often with permanent states).
examples: Near-synonyms: get, turn, go, come, fall, grow, wax
She became a doctor when she was 25.
The weather will become cold after the sun goes down.
The sense ‘state or process of bearing fruit’ has become imposed on fruition as the 20c. proceeded.

senses.definition: (intransitive, archaic other than in become of) To come about; happen; come into being; arise.
examples: What became of him after he was let go?
It hath becomen so that many a man had to sterve.
